name: Shinjou Kaede
source:
Son of Azusa. He is a first-year student at Ijiruri private school. He is quiet and shy, but has a kind heart and is actually a passionate person.

 He's athletic and trains with his mother Azusa every day. After catching both [url=https://vndb.org/c31454]Haruno Tamami[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c31453]Aizawa Misaki[/url] having sex with their sons he asks his mother to help him understand why he feels funny.

[spoiler]He has sex with both Tamami and Misaki and steals them away from their sons to form his own harem.[/spoiler]

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=758836]Getchu[/url]]
